scope: one isolated instance per company; never one shared authority for both companies

stream_state.checkpoint_digest: digest of latest independently verified checkpoint

dispatch_authorization_request.untrusted_fields: All caller/model/runtime supplied values are claims; rebind to trusted control-plane records before authorization.

quarantine_request.effect: lock authoritative stream row; increment epoch; disable dispatch; append audit and control outbox in one transaction

release_request.effect: verify assessment and owner approval; atomically consume approval, append audit, increment epoch and activate stream

concurrency.quarantine_dispatch_order: linearized by same transactional stream row
concurrency.already_authorized_action: potentially_in_flight; stop subsequent actions and reconcile
concurrency.receiver_fencing_required_for_strong_rem: receiver validates monotonically increasing recovery epoch and idempotency key

immutable_action_rules.approval_consumption: single use; unique by approval_id, nonce and action_id
immutable_action_rules.retry: never resend ambiguous remote action without trusted receiver reconciliation

production_dependencies_not_selected: linearizable transactional database and documented isolation semantics
independent per-company identity and key authorities
signed checkpoint authority and WORM storage
monitoring, alerting, backup, restore and failover drills
approval_boundary: architecture and offline synthetic work only; no install, deploy, paid usage, CI/Actions, merge, account access, external action or live trading
